title: Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro Review: The New Standard for AI Audio?
subtitle: Samsung latest flagship earbuds bring advanced AI features and refined sound to the table.
author: Technova Team
content:
The Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro have finally arrived, marking a significant shift in Samsungs audio strategy. These earbuds arent just about sound quality anymore—theyre about the integration of Galaxy AI into your daily listening experience.

Design and Comfort

Samsung has refined the stem design introduced in the previous generation. The Buds 4 Pro feel more ergonomic, with a weight distribution that makes them disappear in your ears even during long listening sessions. The IP57 rating ensures they can handle both sweat and a surprise rain shower without issue.

Audio Performance and ANC 2.0

Equipped with a new 2-way speaker system and Hi-Res Audio support, the soundstage is wider and more detailed than ever. But the real star is ANC 2.0. Using the onboard AI, the earbuds can intelligently filter out specific frequencies—like the hum of an airplane engine—while allowing important sounds like sirens or your name being called to pass through.

Galaxy AI Integration

The most impressive feature is the Live Translation. When paired with a Galaxy smartphone, the Buds 4 Pro can provide near-instant translation directly into your ears during a conversation. Its a glimpse into a future where language barriers are a thing of the past.

Where to Buy

You can find the Samsung Galaxy Buds 4 Pro on Amazon. They offer incredible value for those already in the Samsung ecosystem.
